# HSU, CHE-CHENG (許哲誠) - Personal Official Portfolio

> Personal official portfolio website of HSU, CHE-CHENG (許哲誠), Master of Fine Arts from National Taiwan University of Arts. Showcasing interactive applications, VR/AR engineering, full-stack web development, and 3D multimedia design under a high-performance Tactical Cyberpunk HUD aesthetic.

## Core Sections & Capabilities

- [Projects](https://my-portfolio-website.user46972.workers.dev/#projects): Showcase of 8 featured core projects including Unity VR/AR interactive applications, Unreal Engine 5 3D co-op multiplayer games, full-stack React TypeScript platforms, and LINE Bot applications.

- [Skills](https://my-portfolio-website.user46972.workers.dev/#skills): Technical matrix covering Unity, Unreal Engine 5, React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, C#, Java Spring Boot, MySQL, Blender, and Maya.
- [Certifications](https://my-portfolio-website.user46972.workers.dev/#awards): Official certifications including TOEIC 755 Blue Certificate, Class B Technician Certificates, and international vendor credentials.
- [Experience](https://my-portfolio-website.user46972.workers.dev/#experience): Academic degrees, professor research assistantship under Prof. Hung-I Pai on 3 National Science and Technology Council (NSTC) funded research projects.
- [Art Gallery](https://my-portfolio-website.user46972.workers.dev/#gallery): Interactive 3D art gallery featuring character models, environment design, and digital artworks.

## Technical Architecture
- **Framework**: React 19 SPA with TypeScript 5.8 and Vite 8
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS v4 & custom Cyberpunk HUD design tokens
- **Accessibility**: 100% WCAG 2.1/2.2 AAA/AA compliant dual-mode contrast
- **Deployment**: Automated CI via GitHub Actions and edge delivery via Cloudflare Pages
